title.text: 4. Structured summary: Tracking progress made in implementing and achieving the NDC under Article 4 of the Paris Agreement a

label.text: Indicador 2 - Cambio en la superficie cubierta por bosque natural

progress.text: No aplica, dado a que el indicador hace seguimiento a la meta de mitigación de nivel fijo de emisiones en un año.

target_text.text:
Objetivo 1: Emitir como máximo 169,44 Mt CO2eq en 2030 (equivalente a una reducción del 51% de las emisiones respecto a la proyección de emisiones en 2030 en el escenario de referencia), iniciando un decrecimiento en las emisiones entre 2027 y 2030 tendiente hacia la carbono-neutralidad a mediados de siglo. 

Objetivo 2: Disminuir el cambio en la superficie cubierta por bosque natural debido a deforestación a 50.000 ha/año en 2030. 

Objetivo 3: Reducir las emisiones de carbono negro del 40% respecto al nivel del año 2014. 

Objetivo 4: Establecer presupuestos de carbono para el periodo 2020-2030 a más tardar en 2023.

verdict.text: Colombia pledges a 20% reduction by 2030 against 2030 business-as-usual (unconditional), and 30% conditional on international support. The registry's current submission for this Party is NDC 3.0, filed 2025-12-19. It was read and refused, so the figure above comes from the First NDC (archived) (2018). The document's condition, in its own words: "Emissions (M ton CO2--eq) 350 BAU Scenario 325 20% reduction compared to the BAU Scenario 300 Mitigation Scenario 275 250 225 200 2010 2015 2020 2025 2030 Conditional Target Subject to the provision of international support, Colombia could increase its ambition from 20% reduction with respect to BAU to 30% with respect to BAU by 2030." 50 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35), DS-40 (4). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-35 248.3 MtCO₂e, DS-02 199.5 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. No implementation gap is reported: the pledge is 20% below a business-as-usual projection for 2030. That projection is not in any source loaded here, so the percentage cannot be turned into a tonnage and the trend cannot be judged against it. It submitted BTR1. 5 of 8 components have been confirmed in the document; the rest are unparsed, which is not a finding against the country. ND-GAIN scores it 50.5 for 2024. In the first NDC round, WRI's CAIT assessment recorded: 20% (unconditional) to 30% (conditional) reduction in GHG emissions by 2030 compared to the BAU scenario It was classed both. That is a 2016 assessment of an earlier submission, not the target above. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +1.12°C under SSP1-2.6 to +4.4°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
